# Golden expected-edges fixture: tests/fixtures/golden/typescript
#
# Format, xfail marker, resolution-kind column and scope: see
# tests/fixtures/golden/python/expected_edges.txt and tests/common/golden.rs.
# Only CALLS edges are scored.
#
# Baseline measured 2026-09-23: precision 1.0 (10/10), recall 1.0 (10/10),
# 1 known-failing line.

# Plain call. other_module.localUtil is a same-named decoy.
caller.entry CALLS caller.localUtil exact

# Named import. other_module.formatGreeting is a same-named decoy.
caller.callImportedHelper CALLS helper.formatGreeting import

# Namespace import (import * as helperNs).
caller.callNamespaceImport CALLS helper.formatGreeting import

# Method call on this. LoudGreeter.format is a same-named decoy.
greeter.Greeter.greet CALLS greeter.Greeter.format exact

# Receiver-typed call. LoudGreeter.greet is a same-named decoy.
caller.callReceiverTyped CALLS greeter.Greeter.greet receiver_type

# Inherited method call: Dog extends Animal. Cat.speak is a decoy.
caller.callInherited CALLS animals.Animal.speak inherited

# Interface call through Speaker. Cat.say is a same-named decoy.
caller.callInterface CALLS animals.Speaker.say  # xfail: interface method signatures are not extracted as symbols

# Ambiguous name: run exists in ambiguous_a and ambiguous_b; the import
# picks ambiguous_a.
caller.callAmbiguous CALLS ambiguous_a.run import

# External call: axios is never indexed.
caller.callExternal CALLS UNRESOLVED

# Non-exported function in the same module. other_module.decorate is a
# same-named decoy.
helper.formatGreeting CALLS helper.decorate exact

# Cross-file incoming call into caller.entry.
downstream.useEntry CALLS caller.entry import
